STEP 5 - Volume: 125 cm^2 x ~2 cm average pile height ≈ 250 ml gross volume.

STEP 6 - Grams: 250 ml x 0.6 g/ml (cut fruit) ≈ 150 g.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Roughly 8-9 papaya chunks of about 15-20 g each gives ~150 g, which is a plausible single fruit serving. About 65 kcal is consistent with that amount of papaya.

Estimated total: about 150 g of papaya, about 65 kcal.
